entries.answer: Hello is the everyday greeting in English and it is close to entirely neutral, which is why it works in a boardroom and on a playground equally well. It began as a shortened form of a much older expression and shed its religious meaning generations ago. The useful thing about English greetings is how wide the range is, since any of dozens will work, and formality is carried by the rest of the sentence rather than by this word.

patterns: when do you say good morning
is good morning used at noon
entries.answer: Good morning covers the whole period from sunrise until roughly midday, and morning means the entire stretch rather than the hour after waking, so saying it at eleven is entirely normal. Good afternoon takes over until evening and good evening from about six, with the exact boundary a matter of local habit. The reply can be the same phrase handed straight back, which is why the exchange is short.

patterns: is how are you a real question
how do you reply to how are you
what to say when meeting someone
entries.answer: How are you functions as a greeting rather than as a genuine question, and treating it as a real inquiry is the most common misunderstanding in a first meeting. The expected answer is short and positive, because the exchange exists to open contact rather than to collect information. Answering at length is unusual enough to read as slightly odd, so the normal pattern is a brief reply followed by the question returned.

patterns: how do you reply to thank you
is welcome a response or a greeting
entries.answer: Welcome is the standard response to thanks, and it works in the other direction too, since the person offering thanks may say it as well. In a business context it is a greeting at a doorway rather than an answer, and there it is nearly always plural, as in welcome to our shop. Used as a reply it quietly implies the favour cost the speaker nothing, which is a small but real difference from a stronger expression of thanks.

patterns: what is nice to meet you
definition of nice to meet you
do you reply nice to meet you
ano ang nice to meet you
unsa ang nice to meet you
entries.answer: Nice to meet you is spoken when two people are introduced, and it is normally reciprocated rather than merely acknowledged. The verb is the point, because it casts the introduction as a single event both people are having, and that is what makes a reply feel balanced. Between people who have met before the same phrase gets used loosely on a later occasion, so it is less precise about first contact than its wording suggests.

patterns: what is long time no see
definition of long time no see
what does long time no see mean
origin of long time no see
ano ang long time no see
unsa ang long time no see
entries.answer: Long time no see is an idiom that entered English from a Native American language and is now completely fixed, which surprises learners who assume idioms are always old. It is used between people genuinely glad to see each other again and it implies the gap was not one of anger or falling out. Where the relationship is formal the phrase is avoided, because its familiarity cuts straight across the usual register.
